name: mosaic-headless
description: Build and modify Mosaic Pro (Nextend) WordPress sites by writing the data model directly, with every node type, style property and node property measured on a live install. Unofficial: not made by or affiliated with Nextend.

site_url.title: Mosaic site URL
site_url.description: The WordPress site to read and write, e.g. https://example.com. Every tool in this skill contacts only this site.

rest_cookie.title: WordPress logged-in cookie
rest_cookie.description: The logged-in cookie for an administrator on that site. Run `wp eval-file tools/mint_session.php` on the server to print one; it is never read from your machine. Export it as MOSAIC_REST_COOKIE for a tool run.

rest_nonce.title: wp_rest nonce
rest_nonce.description: The nonce matching that cookie, printed by the same command. Export it as MOSAIC_REST_NONCE for a tool run.
